message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import struct, binascii
p=Path('test/shaping/data/text-rendering-tests/fonts/TestMORXTwentyone.ttf')
d=p.read_bytes(); num=struct.unpack('>H', d[4:6])[0]
ts={}
for i in range(num):
 off=12+16*i; tag=d[off:off+4].decode('latin1'); ts[tag]=struct.unpack('>III', d[off+4:off+16])
print(ts)
mo,ml=ts['morx'][1:]; m=d[mo:mo+ml]
print('morx',ml,binascii.hexlify(m))
# parse contextual subtable fields
ver,unused,cc=struct.unpack('>HHI',m[:8]); print(ver,cc)
o=8; flags,clen,fc,sc=struct.unpack('>IIII',m[o:o+16]); print('chain',flags,clen,fc,sc)
so=o+16+fc*12
slen,cov,sff=struct.unpack('>III',m[so:so+12]); print('sub',slen,hex(cov),hex(sff),'type',cov&0xff)
base=so+12
nClasses, classOff, stateOff, entryOff, subsOff = struct.unpack('>IIIII',m[base:base+20])
print('ctx base',base,'nClasses',nClasses,'offs',classOff,stateOff,entryOff,subsOff)
print('subdata',binascii.hexlify(m[base:so+slen]))
PY` executed with exit code 0.
